# Mobile Banking App FAQs

Here are some frequently asked questions to help users navigate your new mobile banking application, covering essential topics from initial setup to security.

## Account Setup & Access
- **How do I register for the mobile banking app?**
  - Download the app from your device's app store.
  - Select "Register" or "Sign Up" and follow the on-screen prompts to verify your identity and create your login credentials.
- **What information do I need to register?**
  - You will typically need your bank account number, registered mobile number, and possibly your debit card details or national ID for verification.
- **Can I link multiple bank accounts to the app?**
  - Yes, you can link all eligible accounts associated with your customer ID after initial setup. Navigate to the "Accounts" section to add more.
- **What should I do if I forget my login PIN or password?**
  - On the login screen, tap "Forgot PIN/Password" and follow the secure steps to reset your credentials using registered details.

## Fund Transfers & Payments
- **How do I send money using the app?**
  - Select "Transfer Funds," choose the recipient (from saved beneficiaries or new), enter the amount, and confirm the transaction with your PIN or biometric authentication.
- **What are the daily transfer limits?**
  - Transfer limits vary by account type and security settings. You can view your specific limits in the "Settings" or "Limits" section of the app.
- **How long does it take for a fund transfer to complete?**
  - Most transfers are instant, especially between accounts within the same bank or through real-time payment systems. Transfers to other banks may take a few hours to one business day.
- **Can I schedule future or recurring transfers?**
  - Yes, the app allows you to set up scheduled or recurring payments. Look for the "Schedule Transfer" or "Recurring Payments" option within the transfer section.
- **Is international fund transfer supported?**
  - Yes, international transfers are supported to select countries. Go to "International Transfer" for details on supported currencies, fees, and processing times.

## Security Features & Protection
- **How does the app protect my financial information?**
  - The app uses advanced encryption (SSL/TLS), multi-factor authentication, and secure servers to protect your data. Your data is never stored directly on your device.
- **What is two-factor authentication (2FA)?**
  - 2FA adds an extra layer of security by requiring a second verification step, such as a one-time password (OTP) sent to your registered mobile number, in addition to your password.
- **What should I do if my phone is lost or stolen?**
  - Immediately contact our customer support to temporarily block access to your mobile banking app. You can also remotely deregister your device via our website.
- **How can I report suspicious activity or unauthorized transactions?**
  - Navigate to the "Security" or "Support" section within the app and select "Report Fraud" or contact our dedicated fraud helpline immediately.
